arabic text: LAASHE QAASIM PE CHILLAYE AKBAR\nCHHOD KAR HUMKO BHAYYA NA JAAWO
english translation text: AKBAR WAILED AT THE BODY OF QASIM\nBROTHER DON'T LEAVE US BEHIND, ALL ALONE

arabic text: SABR AAYEGA FURQATME KYUNKAR\nCHHOD KAR HUMKO BHAYYA NA JAAWO
english translation text: HOW WILL I HAVE PATIENCE AT YOUR SEPARATION\nBROTHER DON'T LEAVE US BEHIND, ALL ALONE
AKBAR WAILED AT THE BODY OF QASIM

arabic text: DEKHO KHAIMEN ME SHORE FUGHAAN HAI\nGHAM MEN HAR EK NAUHAA KUNAA HAI
english translation text: HEAR THE WAILING MOANS FROM THE TENTS\nEVERYONE IS LAMENTING IN YOUR GRIEF

arabic text: BAAL BIKHDAAE ROTI HAI MAADAR\nCHHOD KAR HUMKO BHAYYA NA JAAWO
english translation text: WITH DISHEVELED HAIR, MOTHER IS MOURNING\nBROTHER DON'T LEAVE US BEHIND, ALL ALONE

arabic text: TUM NISHAANI HO AMMU HASSAN KI\nBAN GAE AAJ ZEENAT VIRAN KI
english translation text: YOU ARE THE HEIR OF UNCLE HASSAN\nTODAY YOU TOO HAVE ABANDONED US

arabic text: TUKDE TUKDE HUWA JISM-E AT-HAR\nCHHOD KAR HUMKO BHAYYA NA JAAWO
english translation text: YOUR PURE BODY WAS SMASHED INTO PIECES\nBROTHER DON'T LEAVE US BEHIND, ALL ALONE

arabic text: BAAL BIKHDAAE BAITHI HAI KUBRA\nKHAAK MALTI HAI CHEHRE PE DUKHIYA
english translation text: KUBRA SITS WITH HER HAIR DISHEVELED\nHE THROWS DIRT ON HER FACE, IN GRIEF

arabic text: DEKHO UTHKAR YEH HASRAT KA MANZAR\nCHHOD KAR HUMKO BHAYYA NA JAAWO
english translation text: WAKE UP AND WITNESS THIS SCENE OF DASHED HOPES\nBROTHER DON'T LEAVE US BEHIND, ALL ALONE

arabic text: AB HAMEN NA ITNA RULAAWO\nREHM SHEH KI ZAIFI PE KHAAWO
english translation text: DON'T GIVE US SO MUCH GRIEF, NOW\nBE MINDFUL OF THE MASTER'S OLD AGE

arabic text: DO TASALLI TO AMMUN KO UTHKAR\nCHHOD KAR HUMKO BHAYYA NA JAAWO
english translation text: WAKE UP AND CONSOLE HIM\nBROTHER DON'T LEAVE US BEHIND, ALL ALONE

arabic text: HASHR TAK HOGI AB AAHO ZAARI\nSAB UTHAAENGE LAASH TUMHAARI
english translation text: NOW LAMENTATION WILL CONTINUE TILL JUDGEMENT DAY\nEVERYONE WILL LIFT YOUR BODY

arabic text: BAZME MAATAM BAPA HOGI GHAR GHAR\nCHHOD KAR HUMKO BHAYYA NA JAAWO
english translation text: EVERY HOUSE WILL MOURN YOUR SORROW\nBROTHER DON'T LEAVE US BEHIND, ALL ALONE

arabic text: AI VAZIR AAH MEHSHAR THA BARPA\nSAB TADAPTI THI AWLAADE ZEHRA
english translation text: O VAZIR (POET'S NAME), IT WAS SCENE OF INTENSE GRIEF\nALL OF ZAHRA'S CHILDREN WERE TREMBLING IN GRIEF

arabic text: ROKE KEHTE THE JAB RANME AKBAR\nCHHOD KAR HUMKO BHAYYA NA JAAWO
english translation text: WHEN AKBAR WOULD WAIL IN THE BATTLEFIELD\nBROTHER DON'T LEAVE US BEHIND, ALL ALONE
